comments: I maintain this tool. Users supply an opaque sRGB foreground/background pair; the tool does not crawl pages. Its AA/AAA text-contrast thresholds support manual checks relevant to WCAG 1.4.3 and 1.4.6 only, not full WCAG conformance. A passing pair is not a complete accessibility assessment. The release date is the WordPress publication date recorded for the tool page (30 September 2026); the tool has received later updates. No W3C endorsement is requested or implied.
features: Free browser tool for manually checking solid, opaque text/background color pairs against WCAG AA/AAA text-contrast thresholds, with a live preview. It does not scan a website or establish full accessibility.
title: Color Contrast Checker (Benjamin Olsen)
